summary: Spyre Therapeutics filed a preliminary 424B5 prospectus supplement for an underwritten follow-on offering of common stock under an existing Form S-3 shelf (File No. 333-297063) as a well-known seasoned issuer. The filing is a routine capital-raising takedown, not a special situation. Terms are blank in the preliminary version: no share count, no public offering price, no underwriting discount, and no stated use of proceeds detail beyond standard sections. Nasdaq symbol SYRE; last reported sale price $93.19 on October 2, 2026. Joint book-running managers are Jefferies, TD Cowen, Leerink Partners, and Stifel, with LifeSci Capital as passive bookrunner; underwriters hold a 30-day option for additional shares. Watch pricing, discount to last sale, and dilution.
